```{r}

```

```{r}
library(limma)
```

```{r}
# Separate gene data from ER Status
gene_data <- rna_data[, gene_columns]
er_status <- ifelse(rna_data$ER.Status == "Positive", 1, 0)

# Run limma test
design <- model.matrix(~er_status)
fit <- lmFit(t(gene_data), design)
fit <- eBayes(fit)

# Get results
results <- topTable(fit, coef = 2, number = Inf, sort.by = "P")

# See how many significant genes we found
significant_genes <- results[results$adj.P.Val < 0.05, ]
cat("Number of significant genes found:", nrow(significant_genes), "\n")
```

```{r}
# From 492 significant genes pick top 80
top_genes <- rownames(significant_genes)[1:80]

# Create final dataset with only top 80 genes and ER Status

# Confirm what we have
cat("Number of genes selected:", length(top_genes), "\n")
cat("Number of patients:", nrow(final_data), "\n")

# Check first few gene names
head(top_genes)
```

```{r}
# Step 1 - Get breast cancer related genes from MSigDB
msig_genes <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", 
                      category = "C2")

# Filter for breast cancer specific gene sets
brca_genesets <- msig_genes[grep("BREAST", 
                            msig_genes$gs_name, 
                            ignore.case = TRUE), ]

# Get unique gene names
brca_known_genes <- unique(brca_genesets$gene_symbol)

cat("Number of known breast cancer genes in MSigDB:", 
    length(brca_known_genes), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Remove rs_ prefix from our gene names to match MSigDB format
our_genes <- gsub("^rs_", "", gene_columns)

# Find which of our genes are in the MSigDB breast cancer list

    length(matching_genes), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Add rs_ prefix back to match our dataset column names
```

```{r}

er_status <- ifelse(filtered_data$ER.Status == "Positive", 1, 0)

# Run limma on 371 breast cancer genes
design <- model.matrix(~er_status)

fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)
```

```{r}
# Make a copy of final data to process
processed_data <- final_data

# Convert each gene into Low Medium High
for(gene in top_genes_final) {
  
  # Get values for this gene
  gene_values <- final_data[, gene]
  
  # Split into three equal groups
  # Bottom 33% = Low
  # Middle 33% = Medium
  # Top 33%    = High
  processed_data[, gene] <- cut(gene_values,
                    breaks = quantile(gene_values, 
                    probs = c(0, 0.33, 0.66, 1),
                    na.rm = TRUE),
                    labels = c("Low", "Medium", "High"),
                    include.lowest = TRUE)
}

# Convert ER Status to 0 and 1
processed_data$ER.Status <- ifelse(
  final_data$ER.Status == "Positive", 1, 0)

# Check results
cat("Data processing complete!\n")
cat("Patients:", nrow(processed_data), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(processed_data), "\n")

# Check one gene to confirm it worked
table(processed_data$rs_ESR1)
```

```{r}
# Convert all columns to factors
# bnlearn needs factor data type
bn_data <- processed_data

# Convert each gene column to factor
for(gene in top_genes_final) {
  bn_data[, gene] <- as.factor(bn_data[, gene])
}

# Confirm everything is ready
cat("Data ready for Bayesian Network!\n")

cat("Columns:", ncol(bn_data), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Better and cleaner visualization
install.packages("ggraph")
install.packages("tidygraph")
library(ggraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(igraph)

# Convert bnlearn network to igraph
edges <- as.data.frame(arcs(bn_hc))
colnames(edges) <- c("from", "to")

# Create igraph object
g <- graph_from_data_frame(edges, directed = TRUE)

# Define node colors based on importance
node_types <- ifelse(
  V(g)$name == "ER.Status", "Outcome",
  ifelse(V(g)$name %in% c("rs_ESR1", "rs_AGTR1"), 
         "Direct Parent",
  ifelse(V(g)$name %in% c("rs_FOXA1", 
                            "rs_KCNJ3", 
                            "rs_NOVA1"),
         "Root Gene", "Other Gene")))

# Save as large PNG file
png("bayesian_network.png", 
    width = 4000, 
    height = 3000, 
    res = 150)

# Plot with clean layout
plot(g,
     layout = layout_with_kk(g),
     vertex.color = ifelse(
       V(g)$name == "ER.Status", "red",
       ifelse(V(g)$name %in% c("rs_ESR1", "rs_AGTR1"),
              "orange",
       ifelse(V(g)$name %in% c("rs_FOXA1",
                                "rs_KCNJ3",
                                "rs_NOVA1"),
              "lightgreen", "lightblue"))),
     vertex.size = 20,
     vertex.label = gsub("rs_", "", V(g)$name),
     vertex.label.cex = 0.8,
     vertex.label.color = "black",
     vertex.frame.color = "gray30",
     edge.arrow.size = 0.4,
     edge.arrow.width = 1.5,
     edge.color = "gray40",
     edge.width = 1.5,
     main = "Bayesian Network - Hill Climbing",
     margin = c(0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2))

# Add legend
legend("bottomleft",
       legend = c("ER Status (Outcome)",
                  "Direct Parents (ESR1, AGTR1)",
                  "Root Genes (FOXA1, KCNJ3, NOVA1)",
                  "Other Genes"),
       fill = c("red", "orange", 
                "lightgreen", "lightblue"),
       cex = 1.0,
       bty = "n")

dev.off()

cat("Graph saved as bayesian_network.png!\n")
```

```{r}
library(igraph)

# Convert full network to igraph
all_arcs <- as.data.frame(arcs(bn_hc))
colnames(all_arcs) <- c("from", "to")
g_full <- graph_from_data_frame(all_arcs, 
                                 directed = TRUE)

# Define colors
node_colors <- ifelse(
  V(g_full)$name == "ER.Status", "red",
  ifelse(V(g_full)$name %in% 
         c("rs_ESR1", "rs_AGTR1"),
         "orange",
  ifelse(V(g_full)$name %in% 
         c("rs_FOXA1", "rs_KCNJ3", "rs_NOVA1"),
         "lightgreen", "lightblue")))

# Save as very large PNG
png("full_network_clean.png",
    width = 6000,
    height = 6000,
    res = 200)

# Use fruchterman reingold layout
# This spreads nodes most evenly
set.seed(42)
plot(g_full,
     layout = layout_with_fr(g_full),
     vertex.color = node_colors,
     vertex.size = 18,
     vertex.label = gsub("rs_", "", 
                         V(g_full)$name),
     vertex.label.cex = 0.9,
     vertex.label.color = "black",
     vertex.frame.color = "white",
     edge.arrow.size = 0.3,
     edge.color = "gray50",
     edge.width = 1.2,
     main = "Bayesian Network - Hill Climbing\nCausal Discovery in Breast Cancer Gene Expression",
     cex.main = 2)

# Add legend
legend("bottomleft",
       legend = c("ER Status (Outcome)",
                  "Direct Parents (ESR1, AGTR1)",
                  "Root Genes (FOXA1, KCNJ3, NOVA1)",
                  "Other Genes"),
       fill = c("red", "orange", 
                "lightgreen", "lightblue"),
       cex = 1.5,
       bty = "n")

dev.off()

cat("Full clean graph saved!\n")
```

```{r}
# Run 500 bootstrap replicates
cat("Running 500 bootstrap replicates...\n")

set.seed(42)
boot_strength <- boot.strength(
  bn_data,
  R = 500,
  algorithm = "hc",
  algorithm.args = list(score = "bic")
)

cat("Bootstrap complete!\n")

head(boot_strength[order(
  boot_strength$strength, 
  decreasing = TRUE), ], 10)
```


```{r}
# Install required package
install.packages("glmnet")
library(glmnet)

# Prepare data for LASSO
# Convert back to numeric for LASSO
lasso_data <- final_data

# Convert gene columns to numeric
gene_matrix <- as.matrix(
  lasso_data[, top_genes_final])

# Convert ER Status to binary
er_outcome <- ifelse(
  lasso_data$ER.Status == "Positive", 1, 0)

cat("Data prepared for LASSO!\n")
cat("Patients:", nrow(gene_matrix), "\n")
cat("Genes:", ncol(gene_matrix), "\n")
cat("ER Positive:", sum(er_outcome), "\n")
cat("ER Negative:", sum(er_outcome == 0), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Run LASSO with 5 fold cross validation
set.seed(42)

# Create 5 folds
folds <- sample(rep(1:5, 
                length.out = nrow(gene_matrix)))

# Store results
lasso_results <- c()

cat("Running LASSO 5 fold cross validation...\n")

for(fold in 1:5) {
  
  # Split into training and testing
  train_x <- gene_matrix[folds != fold, ]
  train_y <- er_outcome[folds != fold]
  test_x  <- gene_matrix[folds == fold, ]
  test_y  <- er_outcome[folds == fold]
  
  # Train LASSO model
  lasso_model <- cv.glmnet(
    train_x, 
    train_y,
    family = "binomial",
    alpha = 1
  )
  
  # Predict on test set
  predictions <- predict(
    lasso_model,
    test_x,
    s = "lambda.min",
    type = "response"
  )
  
  # Convert to binary prediction
  predicted_class <- ifelse(predictions > 0.5, 1, 0)
  
  # Calculate accuracy
  accuracy <- mean(predicted_class == test_y)
  lasso_results <- c(lasso_results, accuracy)
  
  cat("Fold", fold, "accuracy:", 
      round(accuracy, 3), "\n")
}

cat("\nAverage LASSO accuracy:", 
    round(mean(lasso_results), 3), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Run Bayesian Network 5 fold cross validation
set.seed(42)

# Store results
bbn_results <- c()

cat("Running BBN 5 fold cross validation...\n")

for(fold in 1:5) {
  
  # Split into training and testing
  train_data <- bn_data[folds != fold, ]
  test_data  <- bn_data[folds == fold, ]
  
  # Train Bayesian Network
  bn_fold <- hc(train_data, score = "bic")
  
  # Fit parameters
  fitted_bn <- bn.fit(bn_fold, train_data)
  
  # Predict ER Status
  predictions <- predict(
    fitted_bn,
    node = "ER.Status",
    data = test_data
  )
  
  # Calculate accuracy
  accuracy <- mean(predictions == test_data$ER.Status)
  bbn_results <- c(bbn_results, accuracy)
  
  cat("Fold", fold, "accuracy:", 
      round(accuracy, 3), "\n")
}

cat("\nAverage BBN accuracy:", 
    round(mean(bbn_results), 3), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Run Tabu Search Bayesian Network 
# 5 fold cross validation
set.seed(42)

# Store results
tabu_results <- c()

cat("Running Tabu Search BBN 5 fold cross validation...\n")

for(fold in 1:5) {
  
  # Split into training and testing
  train_data <- bn_data[folds != fold, ]
  test_data  <- bn_data[folds == fold, ]
  
  # Train Tabu Search Bayesian Network
  bn_fold_tabu <- tabu(train_data, score = "bde")
  
  # Fit parameters
  fitted_bn_tabu <- bn.fit(bn_fold_tabu, train_data)
  
  # Predict ER Status
  predictions_tabu <- predict(
    fitted_bn_tabu,
    node = "ER.Status",
    data = test_data
  )
  
  # Calculate accuracy
  accuracy <- mean(predictions_tabu == test_data$ER.Status)
  tabu_results <- c(tabu_results, accuracy)
  
  cat("Fold", fold, "accuracy:", 
      round(accuracy, 3), "\n")
}

cat("\nAverage Tabu Search BBN accuracy:", 
    round(mean(tabu_results), 3), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Build the complete causal path
# using ONLY bootstrap validated connections
# strength >= 0.5 means appeared in
# more than 50% of 500 networks

cat("Tracing causal path from ER Status...\n\n")

# Step 1
cat("STEP 1 - What directly causes ER Status?\n")
step1 <- boot_strength[
  boot_strength$to == "ER.Status" &
  boot_strength$strength >= 0.5,]
cat("Gene:", step1$from, "\n")
cat("Strength:", step1$strength, "\n")
cat("Direction:", step1$direction, "\n")

# Step 2
cat("\nSTEP 2 - What causes ESR1?\n")
step2 <- boot_strength[
  boot_strength$to == "rs_ESR1" &
  boot_strength$strength >= 0.5,]
if(nrow(step2) > 0) {
  cat("Gene:", step2$from, "\n")
  cat("Strength:", step2$strength, "\n")
  cat("Direction:", step2$direction, "\n")
} else {
  cat("Nothing points at ESR1!\n")
  cat("ESR1 is the ROOT gene!\n")
}

# Step 3
cat("\nSTEP 3 - What causes FOXA1?\n")
step3 <- boot_strength[
  boot_strength$to == "rs_FOXA1" &
  boot_strength$strength >= 0.5,]
if(nrow(step3) > 0) {
  cat("Gene:", step3$from, "\n")
  cat("Strength:", step3$strength, "\n")
  cat("Direction:", step3$direction, "\n")
} else {
  cat("Nothing points at FOXA1!\n")
  cat("FOXA1 is the ROOT gene!\n")
}
```

```{r}
  V(g_tabu)$name == "ER.Status", "#FF4444",
  ifelse(V(g_tabu)$name == "rs_ESR1", "#FF9900",
  ifelse(V(g_tabu)$name == "rs_FOXA1", "#44BB44",
         "#6699FF")))

# Save as PNG
png("Tabu_consensus_network.png",
    width = 5000,
    height = 5000,
    res = 200)

set.seed(42)
plot(g_tabu,
     layout = layout_with_fr(g_tabu),
     vertex.color = node_colors_tabu,
     vertex.size = 20,
     vertex.label = gsub("rs_", "", V(g_tabu)$name),
     vertex.label.cex = 0.7,
     vertex.label.color = "white",
     vertex.frame.color = "white",
     edge.arrow.size = 0.3,
     edge.color = "gray50",
     edge.width = 1.5,
     main = "Consensus Network - Tabu Search BDe")

legend("bottomleft",
       legend = c("ER Status (Outcome)",
                  "Direct Parent (ESR1)",
                  "Connected Gene (FOXA1)",
                  "Other Genes"),
       fill = c("#FF4444", "#FF9900",
                "#44BB44", "#6699FF"),
       cex = 0.8,
       bty = "n")

dev.off()
cat("Tabu Search consensus network saved!\n")
```

```{r}
# Get direct parents of ER Status
# from Hill Climbing consensus
er_parents_hc <- parents(consensus_network, 
                          "ER.Status")
esr1_parents_hc <- parents(consensus_network,
                            "rs_ESR1")

cat("Hill Climbing - Direct parents of ER Status:\n")
print(er_parents_hc)
cat("Hill Climbing - Parents of ESR1:\n")
print(esr1_parents_hc)

# Build focused path
all_important_hc <- unique(c(
  "ER.Status",
  er_parents_hc,
  esr1_parents_hc
))

# Get edges for focused path
focused_edges_hc <- edges_hc[
  edges_hc$from %in% all_important_hc &
  edges_hc$to %in% all_important_hc,]

# Create focused graph
g_focused_hc <- graph_from_data_frame(
  focused_edges_hc,
  directed = TRUE)

# Save as PNG
png("HC_causal_path.png",
    width = 2000,
    height = 1500,
    res = 150)

plot(g_focused_hc,
     layout = layout_as_tree(g_focused_hc),
     vertex.color = ifelse(
       V(g_focused_hc)$name == "ER.Status", "#FF4444",
       ifelse(V(g_focused_hc)$name == "rs_ESR1",
              "#FF9900", "#44BB44")),
     vertex.size = 50,
     vertex.label = gsub("rs_", "",
                         V(g_focused_hc)$name),
     vertex.label.cex = 1.5,
     vertex.label.color = "white",
     vertex.frame.color = "white",
     edge.arrow.size = 1.0,
     edge.color = "gray40",
     edge.width = 3,
     main = "Key Causal Path - Hill Climbing")

legend("bottomleft",
       legend = c("ER Status (Outcome)",
                  "Direct Parent (ESR1)",
                  "Connected Gene (FOXA1)"),
       fill = c("#FF4444", "#FF9900", "#44BB44"),
       cex = 1.2,
       bty = "n")

dev.off()
cat("Hill Climbing causal path saved!\n")
```
